name: GOG UniverseLAN (Galaxy SDK loader)
notes: Auto-selected when Galaxy.dll or Galaxy64.dll is found anywhere in the game folder (REDGalaxy.dll/REDGalaxy64.dll are ignored and never touched). No bundled asset pack: write_config.ps1 downloads and caches UniverseLAN releases itself under %SystemDrive%\steamcmd\_GOG\UniverseLAN on first run. The exe is resolved from a 'Launch *.lnk' shortcut in the game root, not from a SteamCMD manifest.
